prompt: Continue the Relay static/mock implementation with one bounded determinism fix. DispatchEnvelope.build currently stores dict(payload), which is only a shallow copy: caller mutation of nested dictionaries/lists after build can change envelope.payload while packet_sha256 still describes the old payload. Fix this by taking an independent deep snapshot of the caller-owned payload before canonical hashing and storing that same snapshot in the envelope. Keep the existing canonical JSON hashing semantics and public fields. Do not add a new schema, persistence layer, live provider execution, retry, fallback, API/auth changes, or unrelated refactors. Add regression tests with nested dict/list data proving that mutation of the original caller-owned structures after build does not alter envelope.payload or its packet_sha256, and that deterministic hashing across equivalent nested payloads still holds. Run PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v, python -m compileall -q src tests, and git diff --check.
